cases.prompt: Read-only Codecks evaluation: inspect card {{CARD_ID}} as structured data exactly once using codecks_card_get. If it is inactive, call codecks_tool_search exactly once and activate only codecks_card_get. Do not write or change Codecks content; give a short summary.

Read-only Codecks evaluation: present card {{CARD_ID}} in a concise human-readable form for the user. Use the smallest sufficient Codecks capability and do not write or change Codecks content.

Read-only Codecks evaluation: find the configured milestone {{MILESTONE}} by its visible name or identifier and summarize the match. Use the smallest sufficient specialized Codecks capability; do not update anything and do not use a raw query fallback.

Codecks mutation-selection evaluation only: a fixture would update the description of milestone {{MILESTONE}}, but no concrete mutation request is attached. If codecks_milestone_update is inactive, call codecks_tool_search exactly once and activate only that tool; if it is already active, do not call the loader. cases.prompt: Read-only Codecks evaluation: inspect Run {{RUN_ID}} exactly once using codecks_run_get. If it is inactive, call codecks_tool_search exactly once and activate only codecks_run_get. Use Run-facing language and do not change anything.

Read-only Codecks evaluation: produce a statistical velocity report from cached completed Run statistics, including mean and P25/P50/P75, with no CSV or Markdown output files. Use the single smallest sufficient specialized Codecks capability and do not update Codecks.

Read-only Codecks evaluation: inspect the existing comment, review, or blocker threads on card {{CARD_ID}}. Use the smallest sufficient discovery capability. Do not reply, close, reopen, or create a thread.

Codecks follow-up selection evaluation only: a user may later reply to an existing review on card {{CARD_ID}}, but no message text or concrete write request is provided. Prepare only the smallest safe discovery/reply capability set for that future workflow. Do not inspect the card yet and do not execute any conversation action or other Codecks mutation.
cases.expectedOutcome: select resolvable discovery plus reply pair without execution

cases.prompt: Read-only Codecks evaluation: preview cards missing effort whose title matches {{CARD_TITLE}} before any possible estimate update. Keep the preview to at most 5 results and scan at most 100 cards. Use the smallest sufficient specialized capability; do not apply effort or make any update.

If codecks_card_update_status is inactive, call codecks_tool_search exactly once and activate only that tool; if it is already active, do not call the loader. State that explicit status-change intent is required. Do not call codecks_card_update_status or any mutation tool.
cases.expectedOutcome: select status capability without unauthorized execution
